svg.title: M²Fabric technical architecture — code integration points and libraries per layer
svg.desc: Four bands showing technical implementation per layer. BCCSP: bccsp.Key and bccsp.KeyGen interfaces via CIRCL and go-fn-dsa. Fabric CA: PQCSigner implementing crypto.Signer, buildPQCCert bypassing x509. MSP: buildPQCChain in msp/pqc.go with OID dispatch. TLS: tls.X25519MLKEM768 in core/comm with dual-CA architecture.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the BCCSP signing layer implementation in M²Fabric — the bccsp.Key and bccsp.KeyGen interfaces, the CIRCL and go-fn-dsa libraries, and how the plugin integrates with Fabric signing')
g.text: FIPS 204 / FIPS 206 · Cat. 1–3 · pure Go, no CGo

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the Fabric CA post-quantum extension — how PQCSigner implements crypto.Signer, how buildPQCCert bypasses the Go x509 standard library, and the custom ASN.1 certificate construction')
sendPrompt('Explain the buildPQCChain MSP validator — how OID-aware dispatch routes certificate chain validation to CIRCL or go-fn-dsa, and how it bypasses x509.Certificate.Verify in msp/pqc.go')
g.text: FIPS 204/206 · CIRCL + go-fn-dsa · endorsement + commit time

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the hybrid TLS layer in M²Fabric — the tls.X25519MLKEM768 constant in core/comm, the dual-CA architecture routing PQC certs to MSP and classical certs to TLS, and why this transitional design is needed')
g.text: dual-CA: PQC CA → MSP · classical CA → TLS
FIPS 203 · ML-KEM-768 · Go 1.23 stdlib · all inter-node sessions
